title: ephemeral-diagnostic-funnel-and-priority-playbook-serializer
author: Maya Gonzalez
release_notes: Add an ephemeral diagnostics funnel + compact playbook serializer that enables lightweight on-call probes, PII-safe sanitization, prioritized playbook exports, and a sampling CLI. Backwards-compatible; default retention is off for hosted customers.
pr_body: Summary: Introduce an ephemeral diagnostics funnel service and a compact playbook serializer to produce concise, prioritized runbooks from transient on-call probe data. This PR adds an ingest pipeline for short-lived probes, a sanitization layer to remove PII and sensitive tokens, a priority scorer to rank playbook steps, and a CLI utility to sample and export compact playbooks for SRE/on-call workflows. Motivation: On-call runbooks are often noisy and large; operators want a fast, privacy-safe artifact to hand off during incidents and to feed into automated postmortems. This feature reduces cognitive load, improves triage velocity, and provides a safe way to share diagnostic snapshots.

review_comments: Ethan Park: Nice work — high-level question: can we guarantee that sanitizer rules cover API keys embedded in stack traces? Please add a small audit harness that fuzzes common token patterns.
Maya Gonzalez: Added a fuzz test and extended regex set (see tests/funnel/sanitizer_test.go). Also included a small audit helper script internal/e2e/sample_harness.sh to run pattern sweeps.
Lena Hoffman: The priority scorer looks promising but the weights should be configurable. Can we expose a runtime config and defaults?
Maya Gonzalez: Exposed scorer weights via pkg/playbook/config and added defaults in retention/config.go. Documented in docs/ephemeral-funnel.md.
Samir Patel: CI e2e failed on the first run due to a flaky network mock; tests are green after retry. Approving pending minor docs polish.
Lena Hoffman: Approved after docs polish. Please ensure we gate retention by a feature flag for on-prem installs.
Maya Gonzalez: Feature flag gating added (retention/config.go) and toggle noted in README. Merging once CI passes.
merge_summary: Merged by squash on 2026-02-18 by Maya Gonzalez. Squash commit message: 'ephemeral diagnostics funnel + compact playbook serializer: add collector, sanitizer, scorer, CLI, tests, docs'
notes_for_reviewers: Key safety notes: sanitizer is conservative by default; any new redaction rules must go through the privacy review workflow. Retention is opt-in and off by default in hosted mode. Playbook exports are compact JSON lines with explicit provenance metadata so they can be audited. Performance: collector is optimized for short-lived probes (<5s) and includes backpressure; we measured <6ms median processing per probe in the local bench harness.
how_to_test: 1) Build and run playbook-sampler (make run-sampler). 2) Use internal/e2e/sample_harness.sh to send synthetic probes (see docs/ephemeral-funnel.md). 3) Verify sanitized output in /tmp/playbook-exports and run serializer unit tests: go test ./pkg/playbook -run TestSerializer. 4) Toggle retention via RETENTION_ENABLED flag and confirm no persisted artifacts when disabled.
observability_changes: Added metrics: funnel.probes.ingested, funnel.probes.sanitized, playbook.serializer.size_bytes, playbook.priority.score_histogram. Labels include feature:ephemeral_funnel and retention:enabled|disabled. Added tracing spans for collector->sanitizer->serializer path.
security_considerations: Sanitizer has a layered strategy: regex-based redaction, token-entropy detection, and a denylist for known header keys. All playbook exports include a minimal provenance envelope but never include raw env vars or full stack frames longer than 256 chars. New redaction rules must be approved by Security. On-prem installs can opt to run local-only sanitizer rules via config.
follow_up_work: ENG-1219: Add an optional redact-counter telemetry export for anonymized stats; ENG-1227: Provide a web UI preview for compact playbooks in Console; ENG-1240: Add automatic canary sampling policies to avoid over-collection during large incidents.
user_impact: Low-risk rollout. Feature gated and off by default for hosted tenants. On-prem customers can enable it during upgrades. Improves on-call handoff speed and reduces leaked sensitive lines in shared runbooks.
backwards_compatibility: Serializer output format v1 is additive and backwards-compatible for consumers that only read existing playbook exports. Consumers using the new priority score should handle missing field defaults.
changelog_entry: Add ephemeral diagnostics funnel + playbook serializer (slo-toolkit): opt-in, privacy-safe compact runbooks for on-call handoff.
